ev.q: During 2004--2006, Asian adults had the lowest percentage of current moderate or heavier drinkers (9%)
SOURCE: Barnes PM, Adams PF, Powell-Griner E. Health characteristics of the Asian adult population
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population
Data were combined from three years of surveys to increase reliability of estimates in smaller subpopulations.
